If you have just fallen:
1. Sit still and assess your condition
2. Check for any injuries
3. If you feel pain or dizziness, call for help
4. The watch has automatic fall detection and will notify your family if needed.

About sleep:
✓ Adults should sleep 7–8 hours per day
✓ Go to bed and wake up at the same time each day
✓ Avoid screens 1 hour before bedtime
✓ Keep the bedroom dark, cool, and quiet
✓ Avoid caffeine after 2 PM
Here are some health tips for you:

string-array.name: health_tips
string-array.item: 💧 Drink at least 2 liters of water each day to maintain good health.
🚶 Walk for at least 30 minutes daily to improve circulation.
🥗 Eat more green vegetables and fresh fruits.
😴 Get 7-8 hours of sleep each night to help your body recover.
🧘 Practice meditation or yoga to reduce stress.
📱 Reduce screen time and rest your eyes for 20 seconds every 20 minutes.
💪 Do light exercise daily to improve cardiovascular health.
